title: Evaluation and Management Services on the Day of a Procedure (Modifier 25)

criteria.summary: E/M service distinct from, or significant beyond, the procedure
E/M documentation recorded separately from the procedure note

passages.text: This policy applies to outpatient evaluation and management services, CPT 99212 to 99215, reported with modifier 25 on the same day as a procedure, with dates of service on or after January 1, 2026.
A same-day evaluation and management service is separately payable when criteria 3.1 and 3.2 are both met.
The evaluation and management service addressed a problem distinct from the indication for the procedure, or was significant and separately identifiable beyond the usual pre-procedure evaluation.
The history, examination, or medical decision making for the evaluation and management service is recorded separately from the procedure note.

Documentation supporting each applicable criterion must be available in the medical record on request. Absence of documentation for a required criterion does not establish that the criterion was not met.
